article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Aug 16, 2022 (BSS) - Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina today said that the countries which teach lessons, raise questions about human rights and impose sanctions have given shelter to the killers of Bangabandhu and most of his family members.

"They (countries) give us lessons (on human rights), but they are protecting the killers of my father Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, my mother, brothers, women and children," she said at a discussion meeting organized by Awami League (AL).

Sheikh Ha
